name: cavemio-steps-chart
title: Steps chart
description: A week against a daily goal: days that make it fill in, a wave runs the way you step through the weeks, the totals roll.

cavemio.accessibility:
- The arrows are buttons labelled "Previous week" and "Next week"; at either end they are aria-disabled, so focus stays on them. The week’s name is announced when it changes.
- The plot is one tab stop: arrow keys, Home and End move the readout between days and it is announced politely, saying when the goal was met.
- The scale holds still across weeks (set by the busiest one), so a bar’s height means the same in every week.
- Every day is in a visually hidden table with the week’s total and the days met in its caption.
- Installs Number roll and Text morph. With reduced motion every change happens in place.
cavemio.previewNote: Interactive local fixture. Data and async results are simulated in the preview; the caller supplies application services.

features.title: Step through the weeks
features.description: The arrows move between weeks. The days ease to their new heights in a wave that runs the way you went, and the week’s name morphs.

features.title: A daily goal line
features.description: Days at or over the goal are filled with your primary colour, and the goal is a line across the chart.

features.title: Totals that roll
features.description: The total, the daily average and “goal met on 4 of 7 days” all roll to their new figures.

features.title: Today in progress
features.description: A day still under way is drawn as an outline holding its fill so far.

features.title: One scale across weeks
features.description: The scale is set by the busiest week, so a bar’s height means the same thing in every week.

features.title: Readout and accessibility
features.description: A readout follows the pointer or a touch drag. Arrow keys read each day, and every day is also in a hidden table.

states.title: arrive
states.description: In view for the first time, each day grows from the baseline (620ms, 34ms apart) and the total rolls up from zero.

states.title: week
states.description: ‹ and › step through the weeks; the label morphs, rising from below going forward and dropping from above going back. Days ease to their new heights in a wave from the side you moved toward; the total, average and days met roll. The arrows fade at the first and last week.

states.title: goal
states.description: A line in your primary colour at the goal, with its figure in the scale. Days at or over it are filled with your primary colour; a day still under way is a primary outline with a light fill.

states.title: hover
states.description: A thin line column glides to the day under the pointer (380ms, slight overshoot) and the readout at its top slides along, the date morphing and the steps rolling. On touch, tap or drag across the days.
